key_idea: Whatever Nico eats from the second basket is what was left in the first.
steps: Try it: say Nico eats 3 apples from the first basket. 8 - 3 = 5 apples are left there.
Then he eats 5 apples from the second basket. 8 - 5 = 3 apples are left there.
Try any other number and you get 8 again.
